en.bdb: The Sikhs pass the test given by the true Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਲਖ ਤਾਰੇ ਚਮਕਦੇ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: jiau lakh taare chamakadhe neR na dhisai raat anere|

en.bdb: Despite millions of stars shine in the sky in the darkness of night yet things are not visible even if they are kept near by.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਬਦਲ ਛਾਇਆ ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਪੁਜੈ ਦਿਹਸੈ ਫੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: sooraj badhal chhaiaa raat na pujai dhihasai fere|

en.bdb: On the other hand even coming of the sun under the clouds, their shadow cann't change day into night.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਂਗਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਸਿਖਾਂ ਕੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: je gur saa(n)g varatadhaa dhubidhaa chit na sikhaa(n) kere|

en.bdb: Even if the Guru enacts any sham, the doubts are not created in the mind of the Sikhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਇਕੁ ਸੁਝੁ ਹੈ ਘੁਘੂ ਸੁਝ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ਹੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rutee ik sujh hai ghughoo sujh na sujhai here|

en.bdb: In all the six seasons, the same sun remains in the sky but the owl cannot see it .

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਰਮੁਖੀ ਸੂਰਜਮੁਖੀ ਕਵਲੈ ਭਵਰ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਚਉਫੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dharamukhee soorajamukhee kavalai bhavar milan chaufere|

en.bdb: But lotus blossoms in the sunlight as well as in the moonlit night and the black bee starts hovering around it (because they love lotus and not the sun or the, moon ).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਨੋ ਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਸਵੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: siv sakatee no la(n)gh kai saadhasa(n)gat jai milan savere|

en.bdb: Despite the illusive phenomena created by maya (i.e. Siva and Sakti) the Sikhs of the Guru, come to join the holy congregation in the ambrosial hours.
Reaching there they touch the feet of one and all good and the better one.
